title: Holiday Lights Trolley Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join City Sightseeing this holiday season and experience a unique way to view all your favorite parts of our beautiful city on one of our Victorian Style Trolley’s. Our trolleys are all decked out in the holiday spirit ready with lights, holiday decor and music for the ultimate way to see the city’s beautiful light show this season! Our two-hour Holiday Tour (Including Loading and Unloading) will take you to the best decorated streets in the city while you and your friends and family can sing along with us to all your favorite holiday music. City Sightseeing’s Holiday Light Tour is perfect for family, friends, holiday parties and corporate events. We are ready to have you book today and join us for this beautiful holiday experience.

Featured sites/neighborhoods include:

Smedley Street, where you can get out & stretch your legs
Miracle on 13th St. (Beginning November 28th)
Christmas Village/Love Park
City Hall & Dilworth Plaza
Comcast Building
Washington Square
Franklin Square
